content: Swagger UI has NO official i18n: swagger-api/swagger-ui issue #472 (translation support) open for years; official configuration docs expose no locale/language option; workarounds are forking/patching the React strings or third-party tools (SimpleLocalize); the pre-3.x /lang directory was dropped in the React rewrite; content-level i18n belongs in the OpenAPI spec itself (descriptions/summaries), not the UI chrome.
